senses.gloss:
Bhṛṅgā is the name of a species of bee, later specified as
large and black, in the Atharvaveda^1 and the Yajurveda Saṃ-
hitās,^2 which include it in the list of victims at the Aśvamedha
(‘horse sacrifice’).
1) ix. 2, 22.
2) Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 8;
Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 29. Cf.
Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 96.
